purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Generate Truck Order details.
features: This feature allows the user to generate truck order.
When Haulage information cargo common is available for the PR and its value is ‘N’ then Transporter mode should be ‘C-Carrier’.
Rightfax record is inserted with right fax type as "TRUCK_ORDER". The communication is got from Transporter master for the Haulier code (Email or Fax).
PR should have been generated for the Booking.
For agency not in "ESCDM" or "CRAGS" and AFSYS_TRK_ORD_QRY_CRITRIA_REQ config is set, then query the PR only when its linked to a valid mode.
For agency not in "ESCDM" or "CRAGS" and AFSYS_TRK_ORD_QRY_CRITRIA_REQ config is set, then query the PR only on below said conditions.
a) If container is available then Container seal should exists, the only PR can query.
b) When Transport mode is ‘Not Applicable’ and ‘HAULAGE_INFO’ cargo common available for the booking then only PR can query.
c) When Transport mode is Blank and ‘HAULAGE_INFO’ cargo common available for the booking then only PR can query,

d) When Transport mode parameter is set as ‘Not Applicable’ and Truck check box in parameter is set as Y then if PL’s Transport mode is ‘Truck round trip’ and address is not linked to PR then only PR can query.

e) When Transport mode parameter is set as ‘Not Applicable’ and Truck check box in parameter is set as N then if PL’s Transport mode is ‘Truck round trip’ and address is linked to PR then only PR can query.

f) When Transport mode parameter is set as ‘Truck Round Trip’ and Truck check box in parameter is set as N then if PL’s Transport mode is ‘Not Appicable’ and address is not linked to PR then only PR can query.

g) When Transport mode parameter is set as ‘Truck Round Trip’ and Truck check box in parameter is set as Y then if PL’s Transport mode is ‘Not Appicable’ and address is linked to PR then only PR can query.

h) When Transport mode parameter is set as Blank and Truck check box in parameter is set as N then if PL’s Transport mode is either of "Not Applicable"/"Truck round trip" and address is not linked to PR then only PR can query.

i) When Transport mode parameter is set as Blank and Truck check box in parameter is set as Y then if PL’s Transport mode is either of "Not Applicable"/"Truck round trip" and address is linked to PR then only PR can query.

events.description: Generates the truck order for the selected bookings.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more bookings using the check boxes, clicks the Menu icon near Depot Activity and clicks Generate Truck Order.
